description: Block C1 — GPU collision: two generate-dominated agents launched simultaneously. Both fire their retrieval calls at the same instant (~t=5s), then run multiple generate phases overlapping on the shared TP=4 server. Expected result: TPOT roughly doubles vs single-tenant (~17.8ms → ~35ms); queue_wait_ms rises off its ~0.7ms floor. This demonstrates Continuum's scheduling bubble appearing under concurrent GPU demand.
